installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Modded Valheim installer: SteamCMD dedicated server + BepInEx + r2modman profile sync
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
SERVER=/mnt/server

for tool in curl unzip base64 awk sha256sum; do
  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip coreutils gawk
    break
  fi
done

mkdir -p "$SERVER/steamcmd" "$SERVER/steam" "$SERVER/saves" "$SERVER/.steam/sdk32" "$SERVER/.steam/sdk64"

## ---- 1. Valheim dedicated server (app 896660) ----
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C "$SERVER/steamcmd"
cd "$SERVER/steamcmd"
export HOME="$SERVER"
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "$SERVER" +login anonymous +app_update 896660 validate +quit
  [ -f "$SERVER/valheim_server.x86_64" ] && break
  echo "[install] Valheim server binary not found after attempt $attempt, retrying..."
done
if [ ! -f "$SERVER/valheim_server.x86_64" ]; then
  echo "[install] ERROR: SteamCMD did not download the Valheim server. Check the output above."
  exit 1
fi
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so "$SERVER/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so "$SERVER/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

## ---- 1b. Bundle unzip for the runtime image (it may not ship one) ----
mkdir -p "$SERVER/.tools/lib"
UNZIP_BIN=$(command -v unzip)
cp -L "$UNZIP_BIN" "$SERVER/.tools/unzip"
ldd "$UNZIP_BIN" | awk '/=> \// {print $3}' | grep -Ev '/(libc|libm|libdl|libpthread)\.so' \
  | while read -r lib; do cp -L "$lib" "$SERVER/.tools/lib/"; done
chmod +x "$SERVER/.tools/unzip"

## ---- 2. Mod sync script (runs now, and on every server start if AUTO_UPDATE_MODS=1) ----
cat > "$SERVER/sync_mods.sh" <<'SYNC_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Syncs BepInEx mods from an r2modman profile code.
#   PROFILE_CODE        r2modman profile code (required)
#   EXCLUDE_MODS        comma-separated Author-Name list to skip
#   LATEST_MOD_VERSIONS 1 = use newest Thunderstore version of each mod (BepInEx pack stays pinned)
ROOT="${ROOT:-$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)}"
STATE="$ROOT/.r2sync"
WORK="$STATE/work"
PACK="denikson-BepInExPack_Valheim"
mkdir -p "$STATE"

if [ -z "${PROFILE_CODE:-}" ]; then
  echo "[sync] No PROFILE_CODE set, skipping mods."
  exit 0
fi
for tool in curl base64 awk sha256sum; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[sync] '$tool' is not available in this image, skipping mod sync."; exit 1; }
done
UNZIP=unzip
if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  UNZIP="$ROOT/.tools/unzip"
fi
# unzip exits 1 for harmless warnings (e.g. Windows-style backslash paths); treat that as success
do_unzip() {
  LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROOT/.tools/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" "$UNZIP" "$@"
  local rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -le 1 ] && return 0
  return "$rc"
}
do_unzip -v >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[sync] No working unzip (system or bundled in .tools/), skipping mod sync."; exit 1; }

KEY=$(printf '%s|%s' "$PROFILE_CODE" "${EXCLUDE_MODS:-}" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ "${LATEST_MOD_VERSIONS:-0}" != "1" ] && [ -f "$STATE/profile.key" ] && [ "$(cat "$STATE/profile.key")" = "$KEY" ]; then
  echo "[sync] Profile unchanged, mods are up to date."
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$WORK"; mkdir -p "$WORK/profile" "$WORK/ex"
cd "$WORK" || exit 1

echo "[sync] Fetching profile ${PROFILE_CODE} from Thunderstore..."
curl -fsSL "https://thunderstore.io/api/experimental/legacyprofile/get/${PROFILE_CODE}/" -o raw.txt \
  || { echo "[sync] ERROR: could not fetch profile code."; exit 1; }
head -n1 raw.txt | grep -q '^#r2modman' || { echo "[sync] ERROR: unexpected response from Thunderstore."; exit 1; }
tail -n +2 raw.txt | tr -d '\r\n ' | base64 -d > profile.zip || { echo "[sync] ERROR: could not decode profile."; exit 1; }
do_unzip -q -o profile.zip -d profile
[ -f profile/export.r2x ] || { echo "[sync] ERROR: export.r2x missing from profile."; exit 1; }

# export.r2x -> "Author-Name version" lines, skipping disabled mods
tr -d '\r' < profile/export.r2x | awk '
  function flush() { if (name != "" && en != "false") print name, maj "." min "." pat }
  /^[[:space:]]*- name:/ { flush(); name=$3; gsub(/["\047]/, "", name); en="true"; maj=0; min=0; pat=0 }
  /^[[:space:]]+major:/  { maj=$2 }
  /^[[:space:]]+minor:/  { min=$2 }
  /^[[:space:]]+patch:/  { pat=$2 }
  /^[[:space:]]+enabled:/ { en=$2 }
  END { flush() }
' > mods.txt

EXCLUDE=$(echo "${EXCLUDE_MODS:-}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -d ' ')
touch "$STATE/installed.txt"
: > final.txt
FAILS=0

remove_mod() {
  rm -rf "$ROOT/BepInEx/plugins/$1" "$ROOT/BepInEx/patchers/$1" "$ROOT/BepInEx/monomod/$1" "$ROOT/BepInEx/core/$1"
}

latest_version() {  # $1=author $2=pkg
  curl -fsSL "https://thunderstore.io/api/experimental/package/$1/$2/" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n' \
    | grep -o '"latest":{[^}]*}' | grep -o '"version_number":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4
}

install_mod() {  # $1=full name, extracted in ./ex
  local full="$1" P item b
  if [ "$full" = "$PACK" ]; then
    if [ -d ex/BepInExPack_Valheim ]; then
      cp -r ex/BepInExPack_Valheim/. "$ROOT/" || return 1
    elif [ -d ex/BepInEx ]; then
      cp -r ex/. "$ROOT/" || return 1
    else
      echo "[sync] ERROR: unexpected BepInExPack layout:"; ls ex
      return 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  remove_mod "$full"
  if [ -d ex/BepInEx ]; then
    mkdir -p "$ROOT/BepInEx"
    cp -r ex/BepInEx/. "$ROOT/BepInEx/"
    return
  fi
  P="$ROOT/BepInEx/plugins/$full"
  mkdir -p "$P"
  shopt -s dotglob nullglob
  for item in ex/*; do
    b=$(basename "$item")
    case "$b" in
      patchers|monomod|core)
        mkdir -p "$ROOT/BepInEx/$b/$full"
        cp -r "$item"/. "$ROOT/BepInEx/$b/$full/" ;;
      config)
        mkdir -p "$ROOT/BepInEx/config"
        cp -r "$item"/. "$ROOT/BepInEx/config/" ;;
      plugins)
        cp -r "$item"/. "$P/" ;;
      icon.png|README.md|CHANGELOG.md|manifest.json|LICENSE|LICENSE.md) ;;
      *)
        cp -r "$item" "$P/" ;;
    esac
  done
  shopt -u dotglob nullglob
}

while read -r full ver; do
  [ -z "$full" ] && continue
  lower=$(echo "$full" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')
  if [ -n "$EXCLUDE" ] && echo ",$EXCLUDE," | grep -q ",$lower,"; then
    echo "[sync] Skipping excluded mod: $full"
    continue
  fi
  author="${full%%-*}"; pkg="${full#*-}"

  if [ "${LATEST_MOD_VERSIONS:-0}" = "1" ] && [ "$full" != "$PACK" ]; then
    lv=$(latest_version "$author" "$pkg")
    [ -n "$lv" ] && ver="$lv" || echo "[sync] Could not look up latest for $full, using profile version $ver"
  fi

  old=$(awk -v n="$full" '$1==n {print $2}' "$STATE/installed.txt")
  if [ "$old" = "$ver" ]; then
    echo "$full $ver" >> final.txt
    continue
  fi

  [ -n "$old" ] && echo "[sync] Updating $full $old -> $ver" || echo "[sync] Installing $full $ver"
  rm -rf ex mod.zip; mkdir ex
  if curl -fsSL -o mod.zip "https://thunderstore.io/package/download/${author}/${pkg}/${ver}/" && do_unzip -q -o mod.zip -d ex && install_mod "$full"; then
    echo "$full $ver" >> final.txt
  else
    FAILS=$((FAILS+1))
    echo "[sync] WARNING: failed to fetch $full $ver, keeping any existing version."
    [ -n "$old" ] && echo "$full $old" >> final.txt
  fi
done < mods.txt

# Remove mods that were dropped from the profile (or newly excluded)
while read -r full _; do
  [ -z "$full" ] && continue
  if ! grep -q "^$full " final.txt; then
    echo "[sync] Removing $full"
    remove_mod "$full"
  fi
done < "$STATE/installed.txt"

if [ ! -f "$ROOT/BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll" ]; then
  echo "[sync] ERROR: BepInEx not found. The profile must include $PACK."
  exit 1
fi

# Profile config files are applied only when the profile code / exclusions changed,
# so edits made in the panel survive normal restarts.
if [ ! -f "$STATE/config.key" ] || [ "$(cat "$STATE/config.key")" != "$KEY" ]; then
  echo "[sync] Applying profile config files."
  rm -f profile/export.r2x
  cp -r profile/. "$ROOT/"
  echo "$KEY" > "$STATE/config.key"
fi

cp final.txt "$STATE/installed.txt"
cd "$ROOT" && rm -rf "$WORK"
if [ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "$KEY" > "$STATE/profile.key"
  echo "[sync] Mods synced."
else
  rm -f "$STATE/profile.key"
  echo "[sync] WARNING: $FAILS mod(s) failed to download. They will be retried on the next start."
fi
SYNC_EOF
chmod +x "$SERVER/sync_mods.sh"

## ---- 3. Launcher (BepInEx via Doorstop) ----
cat > "$SERVER/start_server.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
ROOT="$PWD"

if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE_MODS:-1}" = "1" ]; then
  bash ./sync_mods.sh || echo "[sync] Mod sync failed, starting with the mods already installed."
fi

# ---- BepInEx / Doorstop environment ----
if [ -f BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll ] && [ -f doorstop_libs/libdoorstop_x64.so ]; then
  if [ -f start_server_bepinex.sh ]; then
    # Take the exact settings from the pack's own launcher so they always match its version
    eval "$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*export[[:space:]]' start_server_bepinex.sh)"
    echo "[launch] BepInEx enabled (settings from start_server_bepinex.sh)"
  else
    export DOORSTOP_ENABLE=TRUE
    export DOORSTOP_INVOKE_DLL_PATH="$ROOT/BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll"
    export DOORSTOP_CORLIB_OVERRIDE_PATH="$ROOT/unstripped_corlib"
    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROOT/doorstop_libs:$ROOT/linux64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
    export LD_PRELOAD="libdoorstop_x64.so${LD_PRELOAD:+:$LD_PRELOAD}"
    echo "[launch] BepInEx enabled (built-in settings)"
  fi
  export SteamAppId=892970
  case ":${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}:" in
    *":$ROOT/linux64:"*|*":./linux64:"*) ;;
    *) export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROOT/linux64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" ;;
  esac
  echo "[launch] LD_PRELOAD=$LD_PRELOAD"
  echo "[launch] Plugins: $(ls BepInEx/plugins 2>/dev/null | wc -l) folder(s) in BepInEx/plugins"
else
  echo "[launch] WARNING: BepInEx files not found, starting a VANILLA server (no mods)."
  echo "[launch]   missing: $( [ -f BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll ] || echo -n 'BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll ' ) $( [ -f doorstop_libs/libdoorstop_x64.so ] || echo -n 'doorstop_libs/libdoorstop_x64.so' )"
  export SteamAppId=892970
  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROOT/linux64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
fi

PORT="${1:-2456}"
exec ./valheim_server.x86_64 -nographics -batchmode \
  -name "$SRV_NAME" -port "$PORT" -world "$WORLD_NAME" \
  -password "$SRV_PASSWORD" -public "$SRV_PUBLIC" -savedir ./saves
EOF
chmod +x "$SERVER/start_server.sh"

## ---- 4. First sync ----
ROOT="$SERVER" bash "$SERVER/sync_mods.sh"

echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: World save name (created if it doesn't exist).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Min 5 characters, and must not be contained in the server name.

variables.name: Public Server
variables.description: 1 = listed in the server browser, 0 = join by IP only.

variables.name: r2modman Profile Code
variables.description: Profile code from r2modman (Settings > Profile > Export profile as code). Change it and restart to update mods.

variables.name: Excluded Mods
variables.description: Comma-separated Author-Name list to skip, e.g. client-only mods (Author-ModName,Other-Mod).

variables.name: Sync Mods On Start
variables.description: 1 = sync mods from the profile every time the server starts, 0 = only at install.

variables.name: Use Latest Mod Versions
variables.description: 1 = ignore the versions pinned in the profile and use each mod's newest Thunderstore release (BepInEx pack stays pinned). Clients must match!

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Valheim Dedicated Server app ID. Lets the image's built-in updater fetch/update the server at start.

variables.name: Auto Update Valheim
variables.description: 1 = check for Valheim server updates on every start, 0 = never. Game updates can break mods, so set 0 to freeze a working setup.

variables.name: Game Modifier(s)
variables.description:
Sets chosen world modifier with value. If
combined with a preset should be set after. Valid
modifiers and values are:

1. `combat: veryeasy, easy, hard, veryhard`

1. `deathpenalty: casual, veryeasy, easy, hard, hardcore`

1. `resources: muchless, less, more, muchmore, most`

1. `raids: none, muchless, less, more, muchmore`

1. `portals: casual, hard, veryhard`

Syntax example: `-modifier combat easy -modifier raids none`

variables.name: Game Modifier(s) Checkbox Key
variables.description:
Sets a world modifier checkbox key. Valid values are:

1. `nobuildcost`, `playerevents, passivemobs, nomap`

Syntax example: `-setkey nobuildcost -setkey nomap`
